acceptance: Compact monochrome layout with body14 and headings<=24; no marketing hero or decorative halfscreen panel.
Reusable controls/dialog/table/layout components; real organizations, members and invitations, with supported pagination and search.
Create/invite/cancel use actual authorized native BetterAuth; no mock rows or fabricated counts in product.
User/organization-scoped queries and mutation state prevent cross-tenant stale display; logout clears protected data.
Existing account/recovery/verification/invitation flows preserved; keyboard/mobile/loading/empty/error states verified.
A short current-scope user guide distinguishes available features from planned invoices.
semanticRouting: Product scope is current identity administration; UX/visual blueprint precedes implementation. Native member/invitation contracts reviewed before data UI. No logistics rules, invoices, extraction, financial actions, schema or business integrations change. Backend route applies to real-HTTP acceptance tests only.

findings.summary: SPA navigation removed focused control without destination focus.
findings.resolution: Pathname navigation focuses main; tab/page query navigation preserves focus. Independent source and keyboard browser checks passed.

findings.summary: Detail hierarchy omitted current organization name.
findings.resolution: Breadcrumb receives current server-scoped organization context; independent source/screenshot recheck passed.

findings.summary: Cached organization tables could display before fresh membership check on remount.
findings.resolution: Fresh context render/query gating; native IDs validated and browser cached-revocation/tenant race cases passed.

findings.summary: Late create/accept completion could redirect a screen no longer owning the request.
findings.resolution: Mounted guards and user-keyed component boundaries; independent source and late-create browser race passed.

findings.summary: Native sign-in callback could redirect before mounted guard ran.
findings.resolution: Email sign-in omits callbackURL and uses guarded manual destination; mailed callbacks retained. Independent source and modeled native late-login browser case passed.

findings.summary: Absolute visually hidden invitation-table heading caused mobile page overflow.
findings.resolution: Table region positioned as containing block; actual390/320px retests fit exactly with internal table scrolling preserved, no body-overflow mask.
